meta.generatedBy: step10/tools/oracle.mjs (re-implementation of the Vikunja 2.7.0 editor extension set; no checkout code executed)
omitted: Vue node views (MentionUser, TaskLinkView, BlockquoteCommentView): they change only the live DOM, not getHTML()/getJSON()
Suggestion plugins (slash commands, emoji, mention popup), Placeholder, keymaps, paste handler: no effect on parsing
Image blob swap (async fetch); data-src/src="#" shape is reproduced
caveats: style attribute strings are re-serialised by the DOM library (jsdom turns #ff0000 into rgb(255, 0, 0), happy-dom drops "background-color: null"); a browser keeps the string TipTap set, e.g. style="background-color: null" on cells without a colour
data-task-id="{{generated}}" marks a nanoid(8) the editor generated because the input had none (random per load)

dompurify_project_description is DOMPurify 3.4.16 on a jsdom 26.1.0 window: sanitize(input, {ADD_ATTR:["target"]}) plus the rel hook from ProjectInfo.vue; reference only, task descriptions do not use it

the trailing

after a non-paragraph last block comes from StarterKit TrailingNode; it is not in the stored HTML until the web saves the description again
meta.dom: html/json come from a jsdom 26.1.0 window (parse5, the spec HTML parser browsers implement); html_happydom is present only where happy-dom 20.14.5 (the DOM of the web unit tests) differs

readMe.html: editor.getHTML() after setContent(input): the normalised HTML the read-only web view is built from (node views aside)
readMe.json: editor.getJSON(): the ProseMirror node/mark tree; the allowlist a native renderer should mirror
